title: Calling someone on the drive home makes the commute better
dek: The ride home from work is a good time to call a parent or an old friend, and it turns lost time into connection.
body: The drive home from work can feel like wasted time. Traffic moves slowly, the radio repeats the same songs, and my mind keeps replaying the day.

A while ago I started using that time to call someone. Sometimes it is family, sometimes an old friend I have not seen in a long time. I use hands-free, keep my eyes on the road and let the conversation be simple.

What surprised me is how much those calls changed the feeling of the drive. The traffic did not get better, but I stopped noticing it as much. By the time I got home, I had caught up with someone I love and left some of the workday behind in the car.
People often say they do not have time to stay in touch. For many of us, the time is already there. It is just sitting in traffic.
On your way home today, if it is safe and hands-free, call one person you have been meaning to talk to. It can be a short call. It still counts.
